experience.title: AI Review-Response System
bullets: Built and shipped a production **LLM** service that drafts replies to customer reviews for car dealerships: it classifies each review as positive or negative, then generates three reply options (detailed, professional, short) that follow the dealership’s own rules. Now handles 100k+ reviews a month, with 93% of drafts published without edits.

**Fine-tuned** Llama 3 8B with LoRA/QLoRA (Unsloth) on examples generated by Llama 3 70B to fix a rule the small model kept breaking (one dealer’s brand name an exact number of times in every reply), keeping its speed and low cost in production.

Containerised the service with **Docker** behind a FastAPI REST API. Deployed first on **AWS EC2,** setting up NVIDIA drivers and the Linux environment from scratch, then led the move to the company’s own **GPU** server to cut running costs. Added database caching so repeat reviews never trigger a second model call.

Added automatic quality gates (rule-based checks plus an **LLM-as-a-judge** step) so poor drafts never reach a human. Dealers pick one of the three options every time, so their choices double as free feedback on which reply style works.

experience.title: Multi-Agent Sentiment Analysis Pipeline
bullets: Designed and built a **multi-agent LLM** pipeline that turns raw customer reviews into structured JSON for two insight dashboards (a general review-insight product and a sister product for negative reviews). Each agent does one job, from classifying the review to quoting evidence and linking sentiment to named staff. Analyses 30,000 reviews a week (**1.5M+ a year**) and has helped the business win new clients and retain existing ones.

**Cut inference costs** with a two-tier routing architecture: urgent single reviews go to the Gemini API for low-latency responses, while large batch jobs run on a self-hosted Gemma4 31B on the company's own GPU hardware, keeping per-review inference costs down.

Raised subcategory recall from 0.78 to 0.96 (**F1 0.98**), measured on a 500-review golden set of hard cases, then locked the gains in with a regression suite that re-runs the set on every change and fails the build if accuracy drops.
**Engineered a zero-downtime LLM architecture** using HAProxy and active-passive Ollama servers, featuring automated failover, self-healing restarts, and proactive IT alerting.

experience.title: Local RAG Code-Documentation Engine
bullets: Built a **RAG** pipeline that automatically documents large legacy PHP and JavaScript codebases that previously had almost no documentation. Runs entirely on local hardware, so proprietary source code never leaves the company. Cut manual documentation effort by 90% and made onboarding new engineers far faster.

Designed the retrieval end to end: **LangChain** ingestion, 2,000-character chunks, **Linq-Embed-Mistral** embeddings in a **Chroma vector store**. For each chunk the system retrieves related code from across the repository, so the model understands calls into other files before it writes. A local Llama 3 drafts the documentation, and a second “technical writer” pass removes filler and formats clean Markdown.

Made it stable at scale: added a PyTorch GPU-memory safeguard (periodic cache clearing with short pauses) after early runs crashed on thousands of files, and refactored the pipeline into modular, object-oriented Python.

experience.title: Call-Quality Assessment & AI Enablement
bullets: Built an automated call-quality assessment tool: WhisperX transcribes recorded calls and an LLM assesses each one against a set of quality rules, replacing manual QA audits.
